parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: **1**. Valid values: **1** to **100000**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of domain names to display on each page. Default value: **20**. Valid values: an integer from **1** to **500**.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the mitigation policy. You can specify only one ID.
